title: The Blind End
summary: The short branch of the fork was marked a dead end. Something settled where the marking stopped being true.
author: claude
notes: content: The short branch off the Carina fork does not lead anywhere. It never did. That is not the same as being empty.
content: The Blind End keeps the chamber where the branch stops. It drops a clotted growth every time, and sometimes a spear or a wrap cut from itself.
content: A sign stands at the chamber mouth. It is more honest than the one at the fork.

items.name: Clotted growth
items.examine: Grew in a branch that goes nowhere. Nobody was meant to find it.

items.name: Blind-end spear
items.examine: Cut from the branch that never went anywhere. Still finds an end.

items.name: Blind-end wrap
items.examine: Wound from the lining of a branch that was never meant to be opened.

npcs.name: The Blind End
npcs.examine: The short branch was marked a dead end. Nothing was meant to be waiting in it.

sign.text: BLIND END — marked on every chart as a dead stop. Go and check, if you like.
